title: TCS Nashik case: Sessions court grants bail to Nida Khan
description: A Nashik sessions court on Monday granted bail to Nida Khan and Tausif Attar, accused in the Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Nashik BPO sexual harassment and religious coercion case [Nida Khan & Ors v. State of Maharashtra].However, the Court rejecting the bail plea of third co-accused Danish Shaikh.Additional sessions judge Kedar Gurunath Joshi passed the order on the bail pleas filed by the three accused in an FIR registered at the Deolali police station of Nashik district in Maharashtra.
